items.originalTitle: George Russell's tongue-in-cheek Kimi Antonelli F1 title threat: "Get you arrested"
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔开玩笑称带基米·安东内利喝酒可能是阻止他赢得F1冠军的最佳方法
乔治·拉塞尔开玩笑说，带基米·安东内利去喝酒可能是他阻止意大利人赢得F1冠军的最佳机会
安德里亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯、乔治·拉塞尔、梅赛德斯
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说。来自Brackley和Brixworth的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析。
乔治·拉塞尔提出了一项幽默的计划，以阻止他的梅赛德斯车队队友基米·安东内利在美国大奖赛上夺得F1冠军：带他去喝酒。
安东内利有机会在美洲赛道上获得他个人的首个F1冠军，因为他以102分的领先优势进入比赛，在积分榜上排在第二位的拉塞尔之后。为了确保冠军，这位意大利车手需要在美国大奖赛中获胜，而拉塞尔需要排名第八名之外，刘易斯·汉密尔顿需要排名第四名之外。
在比赛周末之前，两位梅赛德斯车手出现在一个粉丝论坛上，拉塞尔开玩笑说，在奥斯汀的夜晚可能是他缩小与安东内利差距的最佳机会。
拉塞尔在社交媒体上广泛分享的一段视频中告诉安东内利：“我可以带你去喝酒。实际上，这可能是一个在锦标赛中击败你的好方法，让你在周日晚上被捕。”
这个笑话让观众笑了出来，特别是这个20岁的年轻人还没有达到美国法定饮酒年龄。
"我真的很喜欢拉塞尔的心态。他承受了太多的仇恨，但他已经接受了今年他做得不够，他只想熬过这一年," 一位粉丝在Reddit上评论道，另一位补充说: "这是个玩笑，除非..."
"现在乔治开始有了正确的想法！实际上，我真的很钦佩他乐天知命，对此开玩笑," 另一个人发帖说。
进一步的反应包括: "你可以看到他脸上的表情；就像'你知道什么，这是个不错的主意。一不做二不休，'" 和 "乔治在自言自语。"
美国大奖赛标志着赛季倒数第二个三连赛的开始，将于10月25日星期日举行。
detailEn: George Russell's tongue-in-cheek Kimi Antonelli F1 title threat: "Get you arrested"
George Russell joked that taking Kimi Antonelli drinking could be his best chance of preventing the Italian from clinching the F1 championship
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
George Russell has come up with a tongue-in-cheek plan to stop Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli from clinching the Formula 1 championship at the United States Grand Prix: take him out drinking.

Antonelli has the chance to claim his maiden F1 title as he heads into the race at the Circuit of the Americas with a 102-point lead over second-placed Russell in the standings. To secure the title, the Italian driver would need to win the United States Grand Prix, with Russell finishing outside of the top eight and Lewis Hamilton outside of the top four.
The two Mercedes drivers appeared together at a fan forum ahead of the race weekend, where Russell joked that a night out in Austin could be his best chance of closing the gap to Antonelli.
"I could take you drinking," Russell told Antonelli in a clip widely shared on social media. "Actually, this could be a good way to beat you in the championship, to get you arrested on Sunday night."
The joke drew laughs from the crowd, especially as the 20-year-old has not yet reached the legal drinking age in the US.

"I really like Russell’s mentality. He gets way too much hate, but he’s accepted that this year he’s not done enough, and he just wants to get through it," one fan commented on Reddit, while another added: "It's a joke, unless..."
"Now George is starting to get the right idea! Really, though, I admire him being good-natured and joking about it," someone else posted.
Further reactions included: "You can see the look on his face afterwards; it’s like 'You know what, that’s not a bad idea. In for a penny, in for a pound,'" and "George thinking out loud."
The United States Grand Prix kicks off the penultimate triple-header of the season and will take place on Sunday 25 October.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli caught on camera hitting fence in Mercedes road car at US GP
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在美国大奖赛中被摄像头捕捉到在梅赛德斯道路车上撞上栅栏
梅赛德斯一级方程式冠军车手基米·安东内利在美洲赛车场被摄像头捕捉到倒车时将他的梅赛德斯-AMG GT 4门轿跑车撞进了一道木栅栏
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
基米·安东内利正站在成为一级方程式世界冠军的边缘，但这位梅赛德斯车手仍然被粉丝在停车场里看到犯了一个错误，这证明了即使是天赋最高的车手有时也会犯错。
这位年轻的意大利车手本周末驾驶着一辆定制的梅赛德斯-AMG GT 4门轿跑车前往美国赛车场，得益于车队与MANUFAKTUR的合作。然而，当他倒车进入与队友乔治·拉塞尔同款车型的停车位时，他有点过头了，撞到了身后的木栅栏。
损坏并不严重，但安东内利向观众展示了他的车技，进行了一次漂移，轮胎烟雾弥漫了整个区域。
在这位20岁的车手表现得异常出色的周末，这算是一次罕见的失误。安东内利进入排位赛时知道，他本周可能被授予F1冠军。虽然可能性极低，但这证明了这位去年才加入锦标赛的车手本赛季的出色表现。
梅赛德斯为马来西亚带来的升级套件引入了新的前翼。安东内利在新加坡使用了这个套件，而拉塞尔则继续使用旧规格以供比较，但本周两位车手都将拥有完整的最新套件。
“自从新加坡以来，我们能够分析数据并更好地理解这个套件的需求，”安东内利说。 “我们仍在尝试找到如何将赛车放在正确的窗口，但我们一直在向前迈进，我们将看看我们能做些什么来进一步提高。”
安东内利以102分的领先优势抵达周日的大奖赛，可能成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。要在奥斯汀夺冠，他需要获胜，而拉塞尔排名第九或更低，刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第五或更低。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli caught on camera hitting fence in Mercedes road car at US GP
Mercedes F1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli was caught on camera reversing his Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupe into a wooden fence at the Circuit of the Americas
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Kimi Antonelli is on the verge of becoming a Formula 1 world champion, but the Mercedes driver was still spotted by fans making a faux pas in the car park, proving that even the most talented of drivers sometimes make a mistake.

The young Italian drove to the Circuit of the Americas this weekend in a personalised Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupe thanks to the team's partnership with MANUFAKTUR. But as he reversed into a parking space alongside his team-mate George Russell's car of the same model, he went a little too far and hit the wooden fence behind him.
The damage was minor, but Antonelli showed off for the crowds and performed a burnout, flooding the area with tyre smoke.

It was a rare slip on a weekend where the 20-year-old has otherwise looked sharp. Antonelli goes into qualifying knowing that he could be crowned F1 champion this week. While it's highly unlikely, it's proof of a brilliant season from a driver who only joined the championship last year.

Mercedes has introduced a new front wing to complement the upgrade package it brought to Malaysia. Antonelli ran that package in Singapore while Russell stayed on the old specification for comparison, but both drivers have the full latest package this weekend.

“Since Singapore we were able to analyse the data and understand better what this package needs,” Antonelli said. “We’re still trying to find how to put the car in the right window, but we’ve been taking steps forward and we’ll see what we can do to improve even more.”

Antonelli arrives at Sunday’s race with a 102-point lead over Russell, and could become the youngest world champion in F1 history. To clinch the title in Austin, he needs to win, with Russell finishing ninth or lower and Lewis Hamilton fifth or lower.
